Movie-App — browse, discover, shuffle

Mockup v4 · 2,060 unique films · every value is real or explicitly blank
All films is the whole database, deduplicated — a film appears once no matter how many collections it belongs to, with badges showing which.
Nouvelle Vague has no formal membership; the list used is the Cahiers du cinéma core plus the Left Bank group, defined in data/collections.json and editable. Films from 1958–1973 are badged as the movement's active period (147 of 341); later films by the same directors are kept so the database stays complete.
Blank (—): Rotten Tomatoes everywhere, and posters for all but the ~50 films in the RSS window. Both need API keys.
